outcome: Need for hospitalization of newborns in the intensive care unit
Complications of the early neonatal period
Total length of stay in the hospital
cohort: 488 women with singleton pregnancy who gave birth to a live child at ≥22 weeks gestation with a fetal weight less than the 10th percentile for gestational age.
finding: Newborns with antenatally undiagnosed FGR have an increased risk of fetal distress, and while they do not have an increased risk of needing intensive care, they do have an increased risk of other complications and longer hospital stays.
mod_finding: The most frequent indication for cesarean section in both groups was signs of fetal distress syndrome.
birth_weight: Less than the 10th percentile for gestational age
